concerns.text: The plan relies exclusively on twelve compositional descriptors (atomic radius, electronegativity, oxidation state, valence electron count for A, B, X sites). Defect formation energies are known to depend on local structural and electronic environments beyond simple composition, so the chosen constructs may not adequately capture the target variable, risking model misspecification.

Sample‑size adequacy is justified only by a heuristic “≥ 500 rows” (SC‑005) without a formal power analysis. There is no calculation showing that this size provides sufficient power to detect the expected effect size for the RMSE or t‑test, which could leave the statistical conclusions under‑powered.

The plan does not describe any strategy to control for composition‑class imbalance (e.g., over‑representation of certain A‑site cations). Without stratified splitting or weighting, the model may learn spurious correlations driven by dataset composition rather than true physical relationships, introducing a confound.
